headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 21, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory, led by Sal Stewart's 2 hits and 6 RBIs. The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Colorado Rockies placed Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain. The Miami Marlins transferred Josh Ekness to the 60-day injured list with a right calf strain and placed Liam Hicks on the 10-day injured list with a low back strain. The Athletics transferred Luis Severino to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. The Texas Rangers placed Jack Leiter on the 15-day injured list with a right ankle posterior impingement. The Baltimore Orioles placed Adley Rutschman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed Blake Treinen on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox placed Isiah Kiner-Falefa on the 10-day injured list with left forearm inflammation.

Several teams made roster moves, including trades and transactions. The Atlanta Braves traded Tyler Schoff to the Washington Nationals, while the Chicago Cubs acquired Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves traded Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win.

top_news.title: **Reds Rout Yankees 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits and 6 RBIs, while Will Warren pitched 5.2 strong innings with 8 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Cubs 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win. Daulton Varsho led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Rangers in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a hard-fought win against the Texas Rangers, outscoring them 6-4. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with a standout performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Yankees 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, led by strong performances from impact hitters Blake Dunn and Noelvi Marte. Chase Burns also made a notable contribution on the mound for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Brewers Blast Braves in 9-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a decisive win over the Atlanta Braves, with a strong team effort that saw multiple players make significant contributions. Impact hitters for the Brewers included William Contreras, Jake Bauers, Sal Frelick, David Hamilton, Mauricio Dubón, and Rowdy Tellez, while Robert Gasser and Bryce Elder stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Castaño Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Bullpen with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff, acquired from the Washington Nationals in a trade.
